A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown the existence of a factorized S-matrix, and derived explicit expressions for the W matrix in the presence of a reflecting boundary.
we have derived the W matrix for all the affine Toda theories in the presence of a single reflecting wall.
the scattering matrices of a factorized S-matrix theory in the presence of walls, are completely determined by the S-matrix and a single additional function, the W-matrix.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in general, the W-matrix is a function of the scattering matrices of the bulk particles, as well as of the reflection matrices of the particles that are reflected at the wall.
the scattering matrices of a theory are not uniquely defined in the presence of boundaries and one needs to impose some additional conditions to make the theory well defined.
the scattering matrices in a system with reflecting walls are completely determined by a factorization condition, which involves the scattering matrix of the bulk theory and the reflection matrix W.
